title: Introduce Chronos-aligned bucketizer and epochal jitter modeler for reproducible burstbenching
author: Maya Herrera
description: Motivation: We repeatedly observe high run-to-run variance in burst-oriented benchmarks caused by alignment mismatch between synthetic traffics and the internal epoch boundaries used by the serving runtime scheduler. This makes regression detection noisy and increases false positives in perf alerts. This PR implements a Chronos-aligned bucketizer that deterministically buckets requests relative to epoch boundaries plus an epochal jitter modeler that replays observed timing jitter distributions to synthetic runners. The goals are reproducible burst placement, configurable jitter semantics, and compact per-epoch summaries for downstream telemetry pipelines. Changes include a new `chronos` subpackage with Bucketizer and JitterModel classes, integration hooks in the session-runner to accept `align_to_epoch=True`, new serialization for per-epoch bucket histograms (CSV + compact protobuf-like JSON), and a reporting pipeline that produces kernel-sample aggregated histograms for each epoch. The description below contains a high-level commit list, changed areas, CI status, review conversation and merge notes. Commits: See `commits` field for individual messages. Changed files (high level): benchmark-lab/runner/session_runner.py - add epoch alignment flag and hook points; benchmark-lab/chronos/bucketizer.py - ChronosBucketizer implementation and public API `bucketize(batch, epoch_ts, window_ms)`; benchmark-lab/chronos/jitter_modeler.py - fits a two-component mixture model from trace samples and provides `sample_jitter(seed)`; benchmark-lab/reporting/epoch_summary.py - exporter that writes per-epoch CSV + compact JSON artifacts; benchmark-lab/tests/test_chronos_bucketizer.py - unit tests for deterministic bucketing; benchmark-lab/tests/integration/test_epochal_replay.py - integration test using recorded trace; benchmark-lab/docker/Dockerfile.bench - added runtime dependency for scipy; docs/bench/chronos.md - usage examples and recommended knobs. Small illustrative snippet: `ChronosBucketizer(bucket_ms=50, align_to="epoch").bucketize(records, epoch_ts=1609459200000)`. CI summary: initial CI run showed 1 flaky timing-dependent integration failure; added deterministic-seed injection and retry harness; subsequent CI green. Performance impact: no runtime overhead in steady-state runners; added small CPU cost during load generation (~2-4% of runner process) but removes variance in p95 across repeated runs (observed reduction from 12% to 2% coefficient of variation in internal A/B test). Related Linear items: ENG-2143 (burst-fuzz stability), PERF-92 (regression-noise-reduction). Merge: merged via squash on 2025-11-12.
commits: feat(chronos): add ChronosBucketizer with epoch-relative bucketization and public API
feat(chronos): add JitterModeler to fit and sample empirical jitter distributions; exposes seed param for determinism
test(integration): add epochal replay integration test and deterministic-seed harness

Lina Gomez: The integration test was flaky on CI due to nondeterministic timestamps. Suggest exposing seed for the jitter modeler.

release_notes: Add Chronos-aligned bucketing and jitter replay model to reduce run-to-run variance in burst benchmarks. Adds new chronos API, integration tests, and per-epoch summary exporter. Non-breaking for existing runners but opt-in via align_to_epoch flag.
